sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Anup Kumar Khare Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
No one has put in appearance on behalf of the petitioners even in the revised call.

This writ petition has been filed with the following prayers:-
"(A) Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of Certiorari quashing the impugned F.I.r. dated 20.08.2021 lodged by respondent No. 3 in Case Crime No. 286 o9f 2021,
under Sections 498A, 323, 506 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.- Kotwali Koach,
District- Jalaun.
Amit Chaurasiya And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 16 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144132160/
1 (B) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus commanding the respondents not to arrest the petitioners in case Crime No. 286 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 506 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.- Kotwali Koach, District- Jalaun."
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
Present petition is accordingly dismissed for want of prosecution.
